name: Hextris original endless six-direction puzzle
scope: Complete original endless Hextris rules, four colors, circular-adjacency flood fill, combo scoring, six wave generators, original difficulty and procedural Canvas geometry. Original and adapted code GPL-3.0-or-later. Native Chinese shell, pure JSON save validation and system fonts replace imported dependencies. Tracking, score upload, ads, remote scripts/fonts, marketing art and all third-party runtime dependencies excluded. Eighteen exact first-party originals are retained in the public source repository for provenance, not loaded by the website. Six unused dependency bundles are excluded from the final source tree; original retrieval hashes remain recorded.
